summary: Allegheny Electric Cooperative, a non-profit G&T cooperative and PJM transmission owner, moves FERC to rescind the E-7 show cause order as to it because it is not a public utility under FPA section 201(f).
ask: Rescind the PJM show cause order against Allegheny as a non-public utility and waive any notice and comment periods.

points.point: Allegheny says it is owned by its members and is not a public utility subject to FERC jurisdiction.
points.quote: Allegheny is not a public utility subject to FERC jurisdiction, pursuant to Section 201(f) of the Federal Power Act.

points.point: FERC exempted other non-public-utility owners from the order while keeping authority over their tariff provisions through PJM.
points.quote: it retains the authority to review each of these entities’ tariff provisions as a component of PJM’s Tariff in an order to show cause directed towards PJM

points.point: Allegheny cites the CAISO order's offer to rescind at a non-public utility's request and notes its PJM tariff portions contain no interconnection processes.
points.quote: we will rescind the show cause order against them at their request

points.point: Allegheny asks for rescission and a waiver of notice and comment periods.
points.quote: respectfully requests that the Commission rescind the PJM Show Cause Order against it, as a non-public utility

throughLine.text: Seeks removal of one non-jurisdictional transmission owner from the E-7 show cause order's list of respondents, the same issue FERC fixed in its August 13 errata.
